_comment: 80s Neon Cyberpunk collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed neon-cyberpunk-1985`, then given a look each (three lines per look; Pikachu's line Tron circuits, Heatran an outrun sunset, Metagross's chrome...). Shared look in styles/_neon.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: 80s Neon Cyberpunk
readme.summary: Pokemon in 80s neon: synthwave grids, outrun sunsets, Tron circuits, vaporwave pastels, acid glitches and chrome.
looks: each line wears one look: synthwave (Duskull, Combee, Purrloin), outrun sunset (Kangaskhan, Gible, Heatran), Tron circuits (Pikachu, Chewtle, Yamper), vaporwave (Goomy, Eiscue, Tandemaus), acid glitch (Seviper, Corphish, Munkidori), chrome (Pinsir, Beldum, Bouffalant)
neon outlines round every part, glowing visor eyes; the neon pulses and now and then a tube flickers, and it glows in the dark
shiny: the neon colours turned round the colour wheel (pink becomes green, cyan becomes orange...)
